name: Контроль ставок по проектам
query:
SELECT
    u.full_name AS 'Пользователь',
    COALESCE(w.wuser_group, 'Not Worker') AS 'Функциональная группа',
    p.project_name AS 'Проект',
    CASE 
        WHEN ptd.pt_cost_level IS NULL OR TRIM(ptd.pt_cost_level) = '' THEN
            (SELECT wl.wl_cosl_level
             FROM `tabWorker Level` wl
             JOIN `tabWorker` ww ON ww.name = wl.parent
             WHERE ww.wuser = ptd.pt_participant
               AND wl.wl_valid_from <= CURDATE()
             ORDER BY wl.wl_valid_from DESC
             LIMIT 1)
        ELSE ptd.pt_cost_level
    END AS 'Грейд',
    (SELECT rt.rt_rate
     FROM `tabRate Table` rt
     JOIN `tabCost Level` rc ON rc.name = rt.parent
     WHERE rt.parenttype = 'Cost Level'
       AND rc.name = CASE 
                        WHEN ptd.pt_cost_level IS NULL OR TRIM(ptd.pt_cost_level) = '' THEN
                            (SELECT wl.wl_cosl_level
                             FROM `tabWorker Level` wl
                             JOIN `tabWorker` ww ON ww.name = wl.parent
                             WHERE ww.wuser = ptd.pt_participant
                               AND wl.wl_valid_from <= CURDATE()
                             ORDER BY wl.wl_valid_from DESC
                             LIMIT 1)
                        ELSE ptd.pt_cost_level
                     END
       AND rt.rt_valid_from <= CURDATE()
     ORDER BY rt.rt_valid_from DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS 'Ставка себестоимости'
FROM 
    `tabProject Team Details` ptd
JOIN 
    `tabProject` p ON p.name = ptd.parent
JOIN 
    `tabUser` u ON u.name = ptd.pt_participant
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabWorker` w ON w.wuser = ptd.pt_participant
WHERE 
    p.project_type = 'Коммерческий' 
    AND p.status = 'Open'
    AND p.custom_payment_scheme != 'Время и затраты (T&M)'
    AND (CURDATE() BETWEEN ptd.pt_valid_from AND ptd.pt_valid_for OR ptd.pt_valid_from > CURDATE())

name: Контроль ставок по T&M проектам_V2
query:
SELECT
    u.full_name AS 'Пользователь',
    COALESCE(w.wuser_group, 'Not Worker') AS 'Функциональная группа',
    p.project_name AS 'Проект',
    CASE 
        WHEN ptd.pt_cost_level IS NULL OR TRIM(ptd.pt_cost_level) = '' THEN
            (SELECT wl.wl_cosl_level
             FROM `tabWorker Level` wl
             JOIN `tabWorker` ww ON ww.name = wl.parent
             WHERE ww.wuser = ptd.pt_participant
               AND wl.wl_valid_from <= CURDATE()
             ORDER BY wl.wl_valid_from DESC
             LIMIT 1)
        ELSE ptd.pt_cost_level
    END AS 'Грейд',
    (SELECT rt.rt_rate
     FROM `tabRate Table` rt
     JOIN `tabCost Level` rc ON rc.name = rt.parent
     WHERE rt.parenttype = 'Cost Level'
       AND rc.name = CASE 
                        WHEN ptd.pt_cost_level IS NULL OR TRIM(ptd.pt_cost_level) = '' THEN
                            (SELECT wl.wl_cosl_level
                             FROM `tabWorker Level` wl
                             JOIN `tabWorker` ww ON ww.name = wl.parent
                             WHERE ww.wuser = ptd.pt_participant
                               AND wl.wl_valid_from <= CURDATE()
                             ORDER BY wl.wl_valid_from DESC
                             LIMIT 1)
                        ELSE ptd.pt_cost_level
                     END
       AND rt.rt_valid_from <= CURDATE()
     ORDER BY rt.rt_valid_from DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS 'Ставка себестоимости',
    ptd.pt_category AS 'Категория',
    (SELECT rt.rt_rate
     FROM `tabRate Table` rt
     JOIN `tabRate Category` rc ON rc.name = rt.parent
     WHERE rt.parenttype = 'Rate Category'
       AND rc.name = ptd.pt_category
       AND rt.rt_valid_from <= CURDATE()
     ORDER BY rt.rt_valid_from DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS 'Ставка реализации',
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT rt.rt_rate FROM `tabRate Table` rt JOIN `tabCost Level` rc ON rc.name = rt.parent
              WHERE rt.parenttype = 'Cost Level' AND rc.name = CASE 
                  WHEN ptd.pt_cost_level IS NULL OR TRIM(ptd.pt_cost_level) = '' THEN
                      (SELECT wl.wl_cosl_level FROM `tabWorker Level` wl JOIN `tabWorker` ww ON ww.name = wl.parent
                       WHERE ww.wuser = ptd.pt_participant AND wl.wl_valid_from <= CURDATE()
                       ORDER BY wl.wl_valid_from DESC LIMIT 1)
                  ELSE ptd.pt_cost_level
              END AND rt.rt_valid_from <= CURDATE()
              ORDER BY rt.rt_valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) > 0
        THEN ROUND(
            (((SELECT rt.rt_rate FROM `tabRate Table` rt JOIN `tabRate Category` rc ON rc.name = rt.parent
               WHERE rt.parenttype = 'Rate Category' AND rc.name = ptd.pt_category AND rt.rt_valid_from <= CURDATE()
               ORDER BY rt.rt_valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) - 
             (SELECT rt.rt_rate FROM `tabRate Table` rt JOIN `tabCost Level` rc ON rc.name = rt.parent
              WHERE rt.parenttype = 'Cost Level' AND rc.name = CASE 
                  WHEN ptd.pt_cost_level IS NULL OR TRIM(ptd.pt_cost_level) = '' THEN
                      (SELECT wl.wl_cosl_level FROM `tabWorker Level` wl JOIN `tabWorker` ww ON ww.name = wl.parent
                       WHERE ww.wuser = ptd.pt_participant AND wl.wl_valid_from <= CURDATE()
                       ORDER BY wl.wl_valid_from DESC LIMIT 1)
                  ELSE ptd.pt_cost_level
              END AND rt.rt_valid_from <= CURDATE()
              ORDER BY rt.rt_valid_from DESC LIMIT 1)) / 
             (SELECT rt.rt_rate FROM `tabRate Table` rt JOIN `tabCost Level` rc ON rc.name = rt.parent
              WHERE rt.parenttype = 'Cost Level' AND rc.name = CASE 
                  WHEN ptd.pt_cost_level IS NULL OR TRIM(ptd.pt_cost_level) = '' THEN
                      (SELECT wl.wl_cosl_level FROM `tabWorker Level` wl JOIN `tabWorker` ww ON ww.name = wl.parent
                       WHERE ww.wuser = ptd.pt_participant AND wl.wl_valid_from <= CURDATE()
                       ORDER BY wl.wl_valid_from DESC LIMIT 1)
                  ELSE ptd.pt_cost_level
              END AND rt.rt_valid_from <= CURDATE()
              ORDER BY rt.rt_valid_from DESC LIMIT 1)) * 100, 2)
        ELSE 0
    END AS 'Рентабельность'
FROM 
    `tabProject Team Details` ptd
JOIN 
    `tabProject` p ON p.name = ptd.parent
JOIN 
    `tabUser` u ON u.name = ptd.pt_participant
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabWorker` w ON w.wuser = ptd.pt_participant
WHERE 
    p.project_type = 'Коммерческий' 
    AND p.status = 'Open' 
    AND p.custom_payment_scheme = 'Время и затраты (T&M)'
    AND (CURDATE() BETWEEN ptd.pt_valid_from AND ptd.pt_valid_for OR ptd.pt_valid_from > CURDATE())
